# Furry Hearts · Inline Metal Shader
Twenty-five plush red hearts fill five staggered rows across a broad beige floor. Each has a slight left or right lean and its own high parabolic bounce. At 3.65 seconds, each keeps its current height and velocity, then drops under gravity and rests on the floor. The hearts break into tufts and disappear between about 5.2 and 7 seconds; the floor remains empty until the 8.4-second scene repeats. Soft floor shadows and procedural fur are built into the inline Metal shader. JSON State advances time by 1/60 second per Loop call, and Loop is capped at 60 Hz. Width and Height control full-screen and saved output; reduce them if rendering is slow. No pointer, texture channels, or external file are needed.
